# GraphAnomalySpikeEncoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method to encode graph node or edge anomalies into temporal spike patterns, preserving structural and temporal information. Facilitates direct processing of graph anomalies by spiking networks, enabling low-latency detection in streaming graph scenarios.
